description: Investigate recurring status degradation caused by telemetry.summary probe timeouts. Keep telemetry availability visible while preventing this optional diagnostic probe from falsely degrading core Hub health. Add a deterministic regression test and validate.

acceptance_criteria: Regression proves a telemetry.summary timeout leaves core status healthy while reporting telemetry degradation
task_telemetry_summary_fix.description: Diagnose intermittent telemetry.summary probe timeout; keep its failure visible without degrading core Hub health; add regression coverage.
task_telemetry_summary_fix.next_action: Restart the installed editable Hub, then verify telemetry.summary timing and overall health.
task_telemetry_summary_fix.title: Fix recurring telemetry.summary status degradation

title: Prevent telemetry summary timeout from degrading Hub status
